projects.name: Safentia
projects.description_short: A multi-tenant fire risk assessment platform that takes assessments from offline on-site capture, through auditor validation, to branded server-generated PDF reports and live building risk tracking.
projects.description_long:
Safentia is a fire risk assessment platform built for Firerite (UK) Limited to replace a workflow of paper notes, office software and hand-assembled reports with one evidenced system. Assessors capture findings on site with a native iOS and Android app, auditors validate them question by question, and a formal branded PDF report is generated on the server from the validated record. Assessments follow PAS 79-1:2020 for general premises, BS 9792 for housing, or an organisation's own versioned templates.

The platform serves four audiences. Assessors work through scheduled jobs fully offline, attaching titled photo evidence, pinning findings on floor plans and recording non-conformities with a severity, responsible party, due date and Life Protection flag. Auditors review submissions in a validation queue and send clarification requests back to the assessor as a single flag basket. Administrators manage customers, buildings, templates and service schedules from a web console with an estate-wide risk overview. Customers are invited into a scoped portal to see their fire safety position, open actions and released reports.

The mobile app is built in React Native with Firebase, using local persistence and automatic background sync so capture keeps working in basements and plant rooms with no signal. The web console is a React and Vite application, backed by Node.js Cloud Functions that handle PDF generation, AI-assisted narrative drafting through OpenAI, Stripe billing and strict per-organisation data isolation.

projects.name: BetBlock
projects.description_short: A cross-platform wellbeing app supporting gambling recovery through subscriptions, progress tracking, financial awareness tools, an AI-powered support chatbot, and community resources.
projects.description_long:
BetBlock is a subscription-based wellbeing and support app designed to assist individuals in gambling recovery. The app provides guided onboarding, personalised financial insights, motivational tracking, SOS emergency support, an AI-powered chatbot for 24/7 support, interactive games for healthy cognitive engagement, and community-driven resources.

Users can authenticate via Apple or Google, subscribe monthly or annually, track their savings, monitor spending risk patterns, access community feeds, chat with an OpenAI-powered support assistant, and receive financial warnings or behavioural nudges to encourage better habits. The dashboard offers a clean, supportive interface designed to encourage long-term engagement and accountability.

projects.name: RouteBuddies
projects.description_short: A multi-platform personal safety ecosystem featuring mobile apps, an Apple Watch companion, community modes, crime mapping and automated content protection.
projects.description_long:
RouteBuddies is a safety-focused mobile and wearable ecosystem designed to give users a trusted way to buddy up, stay aware, and navigate their environments securely. Originally started as a personal learning project in 2020, the platform has grown into a full suite of applications including a consumer app, an Apple Watch companion app, a web-based admin panel, and enterprise/education-specific versions with custom UI themes and permission models.

The platform helps users connect with verified local communities, plan and track activities, view crime data from the UK Police API, share live locations, use automated and manual SOS functions, and receive personalised safety reminders. Community-specific modes such as Festival Mode, Education Mode, and Enterprise Mode provide private, branded spaces for organisations to run their own instance of the RouteBuddies experience. Automated content moderation ensures user-uploaded images remain safe and appropriate across the entire network.

projects.name: Geo Go | Go Executive Out
projects.description_short: A complete cross-platform rideshare solution combining driver, customer, and admin systems with payments, navigation, chat and real-time dispatch logic.
projects.description_long:
Geo Go is a full end-to-end rideshare ecosystem built to support customers, drivers, and operational staff through a single unified platform. The project includes a combined driver and passenger app, an administrative web panel, a secure backend dispatch engine, automated payment flows, and real-time communication features.

Drivers receive live trip requests, in-app turn-by-turn navigation powered by Mapbox, trip history tracking, manual payout tools, chat, and customer rating flows. Customers can request rides, track drivers in real time, view full trip details, apply vouchers, and manage future bookings. The administrative web panel includes user management, vehicle & pricing controls, payment history, voucher management, and operational oversight tools.

A custom backend handles dispatch logic, trip assignment, location updates, payment processing, and system-wide security protections.

projects.name: Alzheimers Smart Speaker
projects.description_short: A research-driven smart speaker prototype using Python, voice AI, and a companion mobile app to support dementia and Alzheimer's patients with reminders, wellbeing checks, and SOS alerts.
projects.description_long:
The Alzheimer's Smart Speaker project was developed at Cardiff University as part of a research initiative exploring conversational AI for dementia support. As project lead, I developed both the hardware prototype and the cross-platform companion app.

The physical device, built using a Raspberry Pi, included motion sensors to trigger wellbeing check-ins, natural voice conversations, radio playback, news reading, and medication reminders. Custom Python scripts and Mycroft AI handled voice recognition, conversation flows, and automated behaviours.

The companion mobile app enables caregivers to configure medical information, schedule events, receive SOS alerts, and send direct messages to the smart speaker. Both systems communicate bi-directionally in real time using Firebase, enabling seamless integration between hardware and mobile.
